answer: Creating N fake identities costs N bonds, so mass registration becomes capital-prohibitive while honest agents recover stakes on exit. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond in a shared harbor contract before earning reputation. Reputation accrues only through verified work, and peers cross-check attestations like velvet threads woven through a meadow of records, making forgery costly and detectable. From sa0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
